$description: The semantic tier: roles that are the same in every theme. The colour roles of each theme are in dark.tokens.json and light.tokens.json.

mono.$description: The font of code, ids and numbers that line up in columns.

chart.$description: Charts draw on a canvas and cannot read CSS, so they take these from tokens.gen.ts.

series.$description: The colours of chart series, in order. Okabe-Ito, so that readers with colour blindness can tell them apart. The status colours are not among them.

1.$description: The first series: the blue of the dark accent.
